name: Crop Image
description: Per-usage image cropping: lets an image be reused with a different crop each place, by duplicating the file behind the scenes and cropping the copy. Ships a browser-backed crop field widget, a media source, and a bulk default-crop action.

suggests.drupal/views_bulk_operations: Enables the "Generate default crop" bulk action plugin.
suggests.drupal/file_entity: Enables rendered file-entity previews and per-file edit access in the widget.
suggests.drupal/filefield_paths: Keeps duplicate/original filenames in sync when file paths are rewritten.
suggests.drupal/media_library: Wires the Crop Image media source into the media library add form.

project_description: This module works around a structural limitation of the Image Widget Crop module: because a crop in the core Crop API is keyed by the file's URI, the same source image reused in several places can only carry one crop per crop type — you cannot give the same image a different crop of the same crop type in two different usages. Crop Image solves this by transparently duplicating the physical image file for each usage that crops it (a `crop_duplicate` tracking entity records the source file, the duplicate file, and the owning entity/field/delta), applying the crop to the copy, and deleting the copy automatically when it is no longer referenced. The duplication and cleanup happen internally on entity save/delete, so editors see no change in workflow. The module also provides a field widget, "ImageWidget crop (with browser)", built on Entity Browser so editors can crop images picked from the existing image library instead of always uploading new ones, plus a Crop Image media source and a "Generate default crop" Views Bulk Operations action.
